questions.question: In pyrrole the electron density is maximum on
questions.explanation: Pyrrole has maximum electron density on 2 and 5. It generally reacts with electrophiles at the C-2 or C-5 due to the highest degree of stability of the protonated intermediate. Attack at position 3 or 4 yields a carbocation that is a hybrid of structures (I) and (II). Attack at position 2 or 5 yields a carbocation that is a hybrid not only of structures (III) and (IV) (analogous to I and II) but also of structure (V). The extra stabilization conferred by (V) makes this ion the more stable one. Also, attack at position 2 or 5 is faster because the developing positive charge is accommodated by three atoms of the ring instead of by only two.

questions.question:
The decreasing order of boiling points of the following alkanes is :

(a) heptane

(b) butane

(c) 2-methylbutane

(d) 2-methylpropane

(e) hexane

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.explanation:
$\bullet$ With increase in number of carbons in alkane, boiling point increases

$\bullet$ In case of isomeric alkanes, greater is the number of branches, lesser is the boiling point.

Boiling point order : $\mathop {\mathrm{Heptan e}}\limits_{(a)}  > \mathop {\mathrm{Hexane}}\limits_{(e)}  > \mathop {\mathrm{2 - methylbutane}}\limits_{(c)}  > \mathop {\mathrm{butane}}\limits_{(b)}  > \mathop {2 - \mathrm{methylpropane}}\limits_{(d)}$

hi.question:
निम्नलिखित एल्केंस के क्वथनांक के घटते क्रम का सही अनुक्रम क्या है:

(a) heptane

(b) butane

(c) 2-methylbutane

(d) 2-methylpropane

(e) hexane

दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर चुनें:
hi.explanation:
$\bullet$ ऐल्केन में कार्बन की संख्या में वृद्धि के साथ, क्वथनांक बढ़ता है

$\bullet$ समावयवी ऐल्केनों के मामले में, शाखाओं की संख्या जितनी अधिक होती है, क्वथनांक उतना ही कम होता है।

क्वथनांक क्रम : $\mathop {\mathrm{Heptan e}}\limits_{(a)}  > \mathop {\mathrm{Hexane}}\limits_{(e)}  > \mathop {\mathrm{2 - methylbutane}}\limits_{(c)}  > \mathop {\mathrm{butane}}\limits_{(b)}  > \mathop {2 - \mathrm{methylpropane}}\limits_{(d)}$
